paper.title: Large Language Model Agents Are Not Always Faithful Self-Evolvers
paper.central_claim: Across four self-evolving agent frameworks, 13 backbones and nine environments, agents consistently depend on raw trajectories but often ignore or misinterpret condensed experience, including condensed-only settings; the gap persists across scale and collaboration and is attributed to semantic limitations, internal processing biases and sufficient pretrained priors.

provenance.notes: 按任务明确要求actual_model/session_id/receipt_ref=null；使用既有sonnet→gpt-6.1-sol配置，不额外探测。a3完整独立重评，替代a1；未读a1/a2、另一席、aggregate、conflicts、旧cal-h2、archive或screen。全文和26张页图已读；40个固定材料/规则hash核对通过。卡片成员结果/录用信息不当作本文证据或评分锚点。

materials.notes: 完整HTML文本；图形数值/渲染示例/参考文献由全部26页固定图补足。

evidence.quote: Our analysis uncovers a striking asymmetry: while agents consistently depend on raw experience, they often disregard or misinterpret condensed experience, even when it is the only experience provided.
evidence.support_explanation: 保留作者广泛原主张，不改窄后重算高分。

evidence.quote: In all frameworks, the LLM backbone remains frozen, and behavioral adaptation arises solely from the accumulation, retrieval, and exploitation of external experiences.
evidence.support_explanation: 被评价留存对象为非权重memory；本文为审计资源B类。

evidence.quote: Remove all semantic content from retrieved raw experiences, while retaining their formatting cues
evidence.support_explanation: 保留脚手架与删除整段不同；不是严格等token长度保证。

evidence.quote: Randomly shuffle the order of steps within each trajectory, preserving content tokens but disrupting temporal coherence and causal structure.
evidence.support_explanation: 内容token保留的步序干预，操作预测可区分。

evidence.quote: Replace the entire content of condensed experience with semantically empty placeholder tokens
evidence.support_explanation: 摘要语义而非仅存在性被干预。

evidence.quote: At inference time, the agent augments the model’s context with the extracted insights and retrieved successful experiences that are semantically similar to the current task.
evidence.support_explanation: 离线经验保存后在部署任务读取；被审计机制不是本文原创。

evidence.locator: Appendix A Dynamic Cheatsheet, text line 1287
evidence.quote: When handling subsequent inputs, the agent retrieves relevant memory contents and incorporates them into the prompt context to influence generation.
evidence.support_explanation: 在线后续使用已说明；分支状态冻结、配对和顺序没有明确协议。

evidence.locator: page 4 image, Fig. 2 caption and panels
evidence.quote: ExpeL consistently relies more on raw trajectories, while showing weak or inconsistent sensitivity to condensed summaries.
evidence.support_explanation: GPT4o/ExpeL ALFWorld：baseline75%，w/o raw0%，raw Empty2.2%，Shuffle69.4%，Irrelevant33.6%；condensed Empty/Corrupt76.9%，Filler75.4%。WebShop baseline30%，w/o raw和Empty0%，condensed Filler34%。作者报告、非复现。

evidence.locator: page 4 image, Fig. 3 caption; Game24 and MMLU panels
evidence.quote: Raw experience perturbations significantly reduce performance, whereas condensed experience manipulations often have negligible impact.
evidence.support_explanation: 反例：Game24 baseline99%，raw w/o46%，condensed Empty84%；MMLU baseline55%，condensed Empty41%。摘要影响并非处处可忽略；caption中significantly未有统计检验支持。

evidence.locator: page 5 image, Fig. 4 caption and panels
evidence.quote: Despite the absence of raw experience, agents show only mild sensitivity to semantic manipulations of condensed experience, indicating limited semantic faithfulness.
evidence.support_explanation: ReasoningBank/Gemini2.5Flash Shopping baseline59.4%，w/o56.7%，Empty51.0%，Corrupt60.4%，Filler63.6%；Map baseline60.6%，Empty51.4%，Irrelevant60.6%。是成功率变化，不是逐决策不变证明。

evidence.locator: page 5 image, Fig. 5 caption and panels
evidence.quote: Agents access two forms of raw experience (reference and execution) and one form of condensed experience.
evidence.support_explanation: G-Memory/GPT4omini ALFWorld baseline72.4%，reference Empty53.0%，execution Empty54.5%，condensed Empty73.9%；FEVER baseline65%，raw61–64%，condensed63–65%。任务差异不能抹平。

evidence.locator: page 17 image, Fig. 8 caption and panels
evidence.quote: We observe similar patterns as in GPT-4o: strong reliance on raw experience and inconsistent faithfulness to condensed summaries.
evidence.support_explanation: Qwen235B/ExpeL ALFWorld baseline72.4%，raw Shuffle76.9%；WebShop baseline41%，condensed Empty28%，Filler31%。raw顺序并非总必要，摘要影响并非总微弱。

evidence.locator: Appendix D.7, page 20 image / corresponding text
evidence.quote: Specifically, we use the gradient magnitude of token embeddings as a surrogate for the attention-level IG score.
evidence.support_explanation: 明确采用末轮prompt的embedding梯度范数代理；不是抑制机制的直接因果干预。

evidence.quote: Task outcomes are labeled as success or failure using LLM-as-a-judge
evidence.support_explanation: 虽AppendixB称WebArena有程序验证，本实验写LLM judge；二者关系/独立校准未报告。

evidence.quote: For agent hyperparameters, the LLM decoding temperature is set to 0.0, and greedy decoding is used. During the experience gathering stage, the maximum number of reflection retries is set to 3.
evidence.support_explanation: 采样设置和收集重试上限可查，不是实际token/调用/美元账本。

evidence.quote: Specifically, for HotpotQA, each task is allowed up to 7 environment interaction steps, and up to 6 successful trajectories are retrieved as few-shot demonstrations during evaluation.
evidence.support_explanation: 任务预算上限和检索数部分可重建；WebShop15步/top2，ALFWorld20步/top2在同段。

evidence.quote: We selected 100 questions from the distractor dev split following ExpeL for our experiments.
evidence.support_explanation: 有样本量与来源，不等于记忆来源/评测重叠实测。

evidence.quote: We utilized the 134 solvable tasks.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者采用134个solvable任务；更大筛选池和失败筛除计数未报告。

evidence.quote: Offline self-evolving agents construct memory from pre-collected datasets and utilize it in a fixed form during inference
evidence.support_explanation: 作者区分离线/在线谱系；邻文原文版本没有独立核验。

evidence.quote: Early studies on faithfulness focus on in-context learning of LMs, where the goal is to assess whether LMs genuinely leveraged human-curated in-context examples to guide their predictions
evidence.support_explanation: 已有ICL/CoT faithfulness思想；本文迁移到动态经验。

evidence.quote: Instead, experience should be retrieved and injected dynamically, based on task demands, interaction history, and internal model uncertainty.
evidence.support_explanation: 未来设计建议，未实验证明修复或接受门控有效。

evidence.locator: page 26 image, Table 7 caption and values
evidence.quote: The evaluation metric is exact match.
evidence.support_explanation: Qwen14B 2Wiki/Musique baseline60/37，raw Empty58/42、Shuffle55/42、Irrelevant60/41；condensed Corrupt58/44、Filler56/44。各100例见§5.3；小净变化不证明先验唯一因果。

evidence.quote: For the agent, we set the decoding temperature to 0.7 and adopt greedy decoding as the decoding strategy.
evidence.support_explanation: 采样设置存在歧义；不猜测实际实现。

evidence.quote: All retrieved insights and interaction subgraphs are injected into agent prompts before task execution, and the memory graphs are updated after each task without any gradient-based training.
evidence.support_explanation: 共享图记忆会动态更新；同段k/M称tunable未给实值，在线匹配状态问题未闭合。
